description: Curated list of high-value government schemes for guide generation. Prioritized by estimated search volume. Use scripts/generate-scheme-guides.js to generate guides.

schemes.name: Gruha Lakshmi Yojana
schemes.notes: ₹2,000/month to woman head of household. Karnataka guarantee scheme. Very high search volume.

schemes.name: Yuva Nidhi Scheme
schemes.notes: ₹3,000/month for graduates, ₹1,500 for diploma holders who are unemployed. Karnataka guarantee scheme.

schemes.name: PM Kisan Samman Nidhi
schemes.notes: ₹6,000/year to farmers. Massive search volume for status check and installment dates.

schemes.name: Ayushman Bharat PM-JAY
schemes.notes: ₹5 lakh health cover. How to get card, check eligibility, add hospital.

schemes.name: PM Awas Yojana Gramin
schemes.notes: Rural housing scheme. ₹1.2-1.3 lakh for house construction. Huge search volume.

schemes.name: PM Awas Yojana Urban
schemes.notes: Urban housing subsidy. Different from PMAY-G. CLSS interest subsidy.

schemes.name: Sukanya Samriddhi Yojana
schemes.notes: Savings scheme for girl child. 8.2% interest. How to open account, balance check.

schemes.name: Atal Pension Yojana
schemes.notes: Pension scheme for unorganized workers. ₹1,000-5,000/month pension after 60.

schemes.name: PM Ujjwala Yojana
schemes.notes: Free LPG connection for BPL families. How to apply, documents, status check.

schemes.name: National Scholarship Portal
schemes.notes: Central scholarship portal. Pre-matric, post-matric, merit scholarships. Payment tracking.

schemes.name: PM MUDRA Yojana
schemes.notes: Loans up to ₹10 lakh for small businesses. Shishu, Kishor, Tarun categories.

schemes.name: PM Jan Dhan Yojana
schemes.notes: Zero balance bank account with RuPay card, overdraft facility, insurance.

schemes.name: E-Shram Card
schemes.notes: Unorganized worker registration card. ₹2 lakh accident insurance. Very high search volume.

schemes.name: Ladki Bahin Yojana Maharashtra
schemes.notes: ₹1,500/month to women. Maharashtra scheme. Huge search volume.

schemes.name: Mahtari Vandan Yojana
schemes.notes: ₹1,000/month to married women in Chhattisgarh. Status check very searched.

schemes.name: Mukhyamantri Kanya Sumangala Yojana
schemes.notes: ₹15,000 in 6 stages for girl child education in UP.

schemes.name: Lakhpati Didi Yojana
schemes.notes: SHG women to earn ₹1 lakh+ annually through skill training and micro-enterprise.

schemes.name: Mukhyamantri Majhi Ladki Bahin Yojana
schemes.notes: Extension of Ladki Bahin with additional benefits.

schemes.name: Anna Bhagya Scheme Karnataka
schemes.notes: 10 kg free rice per person per month. Karnataka guarantee scheme.

schemes.name: Mukhyamantri Yuva Sambal Yojana Rajasthan
schemes.notes: Unemployment allowance for educated youth in Rajasthan.

schemes.name: Abua Awas Yojana Jharkhand
schemes.notes: 3-room pucca house for poor families in Jharkhand. High search volume.

schemes.name: PM Surya Ghar Muft Bijli Yojana
schemes.notes: Free solar rooftop panels + up to 300 units free electricity/month. Very high search volume in 2026.

schemes.name: PM Vishwakarma Yojana
schemes.notes: Artisan skill training + ₹15,000 toolkit + collateral-free loans. 18 traditional trades.

schemes.name: Kisan Credit Card
schemes.notes: Short-term crop loan for farmers at subsidized interest rate.

schemes.name: Pradhan Mantri Fasal Bima Yojana
schemes.notes: Crop insurance scheme. Low premium, high coverage for crop losses.

schemes.name: Beti Bachao Beti Padhao
schemes.notes: Scheme for girl child welfare. Awareness + education campaign.

schemes.name: Poshan Abhiyaan
schemes.notes: Nutrition scheme for pregnant women, lactating mothers and children under 6.

schemes.name: Mukhyamantri Seekho Kamao Yojana MP
schemes.notes: Skill training + ₹8,000-10,000 stipend per month for youth in MP.

schemes.name: Namo Shetkari Mahasanman Nidhi Maharashtra
schemes.notes: ₹6,000/year state top-up for farmers in Maharashtra (in addition to PM Kisan).

schemes.name: Subhadra Yojana Odisha
schemes.notes: ₹10,000/year (₹5,000 twice) to women aged 21-60 in Odisha. High search volume.

schemes.name: Rajshri Yojana Rajasthan
schemes.notes: ₹50,000 in 6 installments for girl child education in Rajasthan.

schemes.name: PMEGP Scheme

schemes.name: Agnipath Agniveer Scheme

schemes.name: PM SVANidhi Scheme
schemes.notes: ₹10,000-50,000 collateral-free loan for street vendors.

schemes.name: Startup India Scheme
schemes.notes: DPIIT recognition, tax exemptions, funding support for startups.

schemes.name: PM Kisan Maan Dhan Yojana
schemes.notes: ₹3,000/month pension for small/marginal farmers after age 60. Register via CSC.

schemes.name: Paramparagat Krishi Vikas Yojana
schemes.notes: ₹50,000/ha over 3 years for organic farming clusters. PGS certification.

schemes.name: PM Krishi Sinchayee Yojana

schemes.name: PM Kusum Yojana

schemes.name: Soil Health Card Scheme
schemes.notes: Free soil testing and Soil Health Card for farmers with nutrient recommendations.

schemes.name: PM Matsya Sampada Yojana

schemes.name: National Horticulture Mission
schemes.notes: Subsidy on fruit/vegetable/flower/spice cultivation, cold storage, pack houses.

schemes.name: PM FME Scheme
schemes.notes: Up to ₹10 lakh credit-linked subsidy for micro food processing units. FPOs, SHGs, co-ops.

schemes.name: Agriculture Infrastructure Fund
schemes.notes: 3% interest subsidy on loans up to ₹2 crore for post-harvest infra (cold storage, silos, grading).

schemes.name: National Livestock Mission
schemes.notes: Subsidy for goat, pig, poultry units. Breed improvement. Fodder development.

schemes.name: Rashtriya Gokul Mission
schemes.notes: Breed improvement for indigenous cattle and buffalo. Gokul Grams, Kamdhenu Sankrit.

schemes.name: PM AASHA Scheme
schemes.notes: MSP price support for oilseeds and pulses. Price Deficiency Payment Scheme (PDPS).

schemes.name: National Beekeeping and Honey Mission
schemes.notes: Subsidy on bee boxes, honey extraction, training for beekeepers.

schemes.name: Gramin Bhandaran Yojana
schemes.notes: Capital subsidy for rural godown/warehouse construction. 25-33.33% subsidy via NABARD.

schemes.name: National Mission on Edible Oils – Oil Palm
schemes.notes: Price assurance + subsidy for oil palm cultivation in NE India, Andaman, tribal areas.

schemes.name: Janani Suraksha Yojana
schemes.notes: ₹1,400 (rural) / ₹1,000 (urban) cash to BPL women for institutional delivery.

schemes.name: Pradhan Mantri Matru Vandana Yojana
schemes.notes: ₹5,000 in 3 installments to pregnant and lactating mothers for first live birth.

schemes.name: Mission Indradhanush
schemes.notes: Full vaccination for children under 2 and pregnant women. 12 vaccine-preventable diseases.

schemes.name: Nikshay Poshan Yojana
schemes.notes: ₹500/month nutritional support for TB patients till treatment completion. DBT to bank.

schemes.name: Janaushadhi Scheme
schemes.notes: Generic medicines at 50-90% less than branded rates. 10,000+ PM Janaushadhi Kendras.

schemes.name: Rashtriya Arogya Nidhi
schemes.notes: Financial aid up to ₹15 lakh for BPL patients with life-threatening diseases at govt hospitals.

schemes.name: Niramaya Health Insurance
schemes.notes: ₹1 lakh health insurance for persons with disability. ₹500/year premium (BPL: ₹250).

schemes.name: Rashtriya Bal Swasthya Karyakram
schemes.notes: Free health screening for children 0-18 for 4 D's: defects, diseases, deficiencies, developmental delays.

schemes.name: PM CARES for Children
schemes.notes: Support for children orphaned by COVID-19. Free education, ₹10 lakh at 23, health cover.

schemes.name: National AYUSH Mission
schemes.notes: Promotion of Ayurveda, Yoga, Naturopathy, Unani, Siddha, Homeopathy through govt institutions.

schemes.name: Pradhan Mantri Surakshit Matritva Abhiyan
schemes.notes: Free antenatal checkup on 9th of every month for pregnant women at govt health facilities.

schemes.name: PM Jan Arogya Yojana (Top-Up)
schemes.notes: Additional ₹5 lakh insurance for senior citizens 70+ under Ayushman Bharat umbrella.

schemes.name: National Mental Health Programme
schemes.notes: District Mental Health Programme. Free counselling, medicines at community health centres.

schemes.name: PM TB Mukt Bharat Abhiyan
schemes.notes: Ni-kshay Mitra donors adopt TB patients. Nutritional support + care. Goal: TB-free India by 2025.

schemes.name: Pradhan Mantri Jeevan Jyoti Bima Yojana
schemes.notes: ₹2 lakh life insurance for ₹436/year. For 18-50 age group with bank account.

schemes.name: Pradhan Mantri Suraksha Bima Yojana
schemes.notes: ₹2 lakh accidental death/disability insurance for just ₹20/year. 18-70 age group.

schemes.name: PM YASASVI Scholarship
schemes.notes: ₹75,000–₹1.25 lakh/year for Class 9-12 OBC/EWS/NT/DNT students. NTA conducts exam.

schemes.name: Post Matric Scholarship SC Students

schemes.name: Post Matric Scholarship ST Students
schemes.notes: Maintenance allowance + tuition fees for ST students in Class 11 onwards. Apply via NSP.

schemes.name: Post Matric Scholarship OBC
schemes.notes: Maintenance allowance for OBC students from Class 11 onwards. Dr. Ambedkar Post Matric Scholarship.

schemes.name: NMMS Scholarship
schemes.notes: ₹12,000/year (₹1,000/month) for meritorious Class 9-12 students from economically weaker sections.

schemes.name: AICTE Pragati Scholarship Girls
schemes.notes: ₹50,000/year for girls in AICTE-approved technical institutes. First 2 girls per family.

schemes.name: Ishan Uday Scholarship NE Students
schemes.notes: ₹5,400-7,800/month for NE India students for undergraduate studies.

schemes.name: Samagra Shiksha Abhiyan
schemes.notes: Integrated school education scheme. Textbooks, uniforms, MDM, digital education.

schemes.name: PM POSHAN Mid Day Meal Scheme

schemes.name: Eklavya Model Residential Schools

schemes.name: Pre Matric Scholarship SC ST Minorities

schemes.name: MGNREGS 100 Days Work

schemes.name: Senior Citizen Savings Scheme

schemes.name: Public Provident Fund PPF

schemes.name: PM Kaushal Vikas Yojana

schemes.name: Deen Dayal Upadhyay Grameen Kaushalya Yojana

schemes.name: NAPS National Apprenticeship Promotion

schemes.name: Stand Up India Scheme

schemes.name: PM Shram Yogi Maan-dhan

schemes.name: SIDBI SMILE Loan

schemes.name: Technology Upgradation Fund Scheme TUFS

schemes.name: NSAP National Social Assistance Programme

schemes.name: Indira Gandhi National Disability Pension
